newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 27.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

** The Dow Jones industrial average fell 28.85 points to close at 5,693.89 in the second-slowest session of the year on Monday as a spurt in long-term interest rates to the seven percent level lured investors to the bond market.
** Indonesia's central bank said it will tighten its monitoring system following a seven billion rupiah transaction fraud which was uncovered at the bank last week.

** Lawyers for ousted Indonesian Democratic Party leader Megawati Sukarnoputri and the government and her political rivals expected to meet in bid to achieve out-of-court settlement before her suit resumes in District Court on Thursday. Meeting likely to be held this evening.
** The Jakarta Composite Index rose 3.53 points, or 0.64 percent, to close at 552.74 points on Monday despite weak regional markets following active trade in selected second-liners and blue chips.
** On Tuesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,342.00/42.25 in early trading against an opening of 2,341.50/42.50.
** Investment holding firm Dharmala Sakti and pharmaceutical firm Tempo Scan Pacific on announcements of H1 results.
** Shipping firm Berlian Laju Tanker on talk of possible sustained strong earnings following government regulations allowing domestic firms to import vessels.
** Property firm Duta Anggada on news reports of a strategic alliance with Singapore-based property firm Hong Leong Group.
** Jembo Cable on market talk of possible acquisitions.
